title: 21 Sales Conversations for a Customer Support SaaS
challenge: A customer service technology platform faced stiff competition from established software providers. It needed to build credibility and generate conversations with customer experience leaders.
solution: Myntmore repositioned its messaging around customer support efficiency, response times and team productivity. We implemented founder-led content and segmented outreach to CX leaders, support heads and operations managers.
results: Higher engagement from mid-market CX teams.
